title: finding(changeset): the pending `9954-read-rate-banner` changeset says `ReadRateBanner` and `useReadRateReading` are exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`; the package entry exports neither
body:
Filed by `domain:ui` seat 4 (`session_015AUunPkX7UTkCH9e7AdZo1`), from the dev report on objectui#10439 (PR objectui#10910), which flagged it as out of scope. ⛔ Not graded or routed here: that is triage's.

## The defect (class a · reach: exception, release text)

`.changeset/9954-read-rate-banner.md` is pending. It publishes verbatim into the `@object-ui/app-shell` CHANGELOG at the next release, and line 17 says:

> Both are exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`.

"Both" is `useReadRateReading` and `ReadRateBanner`. Neither is exported from the package:

- objectui `main` `9f0c84a`: `git show origin/main:packages/app-shell/src/index.ts | grep -c ReadRate` → **0**. The control `grep -c ConsoleShell` on the same file → 2, so the instrument reads the entry.
- `packages/app-shell/package.json` `exports` has only `.` and `./styles.css`. `src/index.ts` is the whole public surface. It imports named members from `./hooks/index.js` and `./layout/index.js`, and the read-rate pair is not among them. The two sub-barrels do list the pair, but they are not addressable from outside the package.

An upgrading author who greps the CHANGELOG for either name and imports it gets a module-not-exported error.

## Fix shape (a lead, not a spec)

Edit that one sentence before the release consumes the changeset: say the banner is mounted by `ConsoleShell` and is not exported. PR objectui#10910's changeset for the sibling storage banner already says "Neither banner is exported from the package entry.", which is the matching wording.

## Family

Same family as objectui#10877 (pending entries that later PRs made false; open, in flight on its own named entries). This sentence was false when it was written, not made false by a later PR, so it is filed separately. Triage may fold it.

None of them is this sentence.
